content.json:
# University of Newcastle — Cybersecurity Posture Dashboard (Native)
**Classification: TLP:AMBER — Internal use only**

> This workbook uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Okta, Mimecast, and native Sentinel tables. No Armis connector required.
>
> **Required connectors:** MDE (`DeviceInfo`, `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities`), Okta (`Okta_CL` or `OktaSSO`), Mimecast (`CommonSecurityLog` or `MimecastSEGEvent_CL`), Entra ID (`SigninLogs`), and standard Sentinel tables.
>
> **CISA KEV:** The Vulnerabilities tab requires a Sentinel Watchlist named `CISA-KEV` with `cveID` as the SearchKey. See the Setup tab for import instructions.

content.json:
## Current Security Posture
Tiles draw from MDE, Sentinel, and Entra ID for the selected time range.

content.title: Open Critical / High Alerts

content.query:
// Open P1/P2 Sentinel incidents — deduplicated to current status
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ("High", "Critical")
| where Status !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| summarize ['Open P1/P2 Incidents']=count()
content.title: Open P1 / P2 Incidents
CISA KEV Matches (MDE)
VIB Q1 Priority CVEs in Environment

content.query:
// High/Critical risk devices currently onboarded in MDE
union isfuzzy=true DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| extend ExposureLevel = column_ifexists('ExposureLevel', 'Unknown')
| where ExposureLevel in ("High", "Critical")
| summarize ['High-Risk Devices']=count()
content.title: High-Risk Devices (MDE)
Risky Sign-ins (Entra)
Avg MTTR (hours)
Alert Severity Breakdown
Alert Trend by Severity

content.query:
// Open alerts — actionable list for CISO, all sources
union isfuzzy=true SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Status !in ("Resolved", "Closed")
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, ProviderName, Description, AlertLink
| sort by AlertSeverity asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 20
content.title: Open Alerts (Latest 20, All Sources)

content.json:
## Device Risk
> Sourced from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Requires the MDE connector and sufficient device onboarding coverage.
>
> `DeviceInfo` records update when device state changes. Use `arg_max(TimeGenerated, *)` to get the current state per device. Devices that have not reported in the time window will not appear — extend the time range or use `ago(7d)` in a custom query if you need full inventory.

content.query:
// MDE device exposure level distribution - current state
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| extend ExposureLevel = column_ifexists("ExposureLevel", "Unknown")
| summarize DeviceCount = count() by ExposureLevel
| sort by
    case(
        ExposureLevel == "VeryHigh", 1,
        ExposureLevel == "High",     2,
        ExposureLevel == "Medium",   3,
        ExposureLevel == "Low",      4,
        5
    )
content.title: Devices by Risk Score (MDE)
Onboarding Coverage

content.query:
// Device count by OS platform
union isfuzzy=true DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize Count=count() by OSPlatform
| sort by Count desc
content.title: Devices by OS Platform

content.query:
// High-risk devices triage list (Defender-aligned)
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| extend
    ExposureLevel = column_ifexists("ExposureLevel", "Unknown"),
    RiskScore     = column_ifexists("RiskScore", "Unknown"),
    SensorHealth  = column_ifexists("SensorHealthState", "Unknown")
| where
    ExposureLevel in ("High", "VeryHigh")
    or RiskScore in ("High", "Critical")
| project
    DeviceName,
    ExposureLevel,
    RiskScore,
    SensorHealth,
    OSPlatform,
    OSVersion,
    OnboardingStatus,
    LastSeen = TimeGenerated
| sort by
    ExposureLevel desc,
    SensorHealth asc,
    LastSeen asc
| take 30
content.title: High / Critical Risk Devices

content.query:
// Devices with impaired or missing sensor - blind spots
union isfuzzy=true DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| extend SensorHealth = column_ifexists('SensorHealthState', '')
| extend RiskScore    = column_ifexists('RiskScore', 'Unknown')
| where SensorHealth !in ("Active", "")
| project DeviceName, SensorHealth, OSPlatform, RiskScore, LastSeen=TimeGenerated
| sort by LastSeen asc
| take 30
content.title: Devices with Impaired / Missing Sensor

content.query:
// Devices that can be onboarded but are not yet onboarded — coverage gap
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| where OnboardingStatus == "CanBeOnboarded"
| extend
    LastSeen     = TimeGenerated,
    SensorHealth = column_ifexists("SensorHealthState", "Unknown")
| project
    DeviceName,
    OSPlatform,
    OSVersion,
    SensorHealth,
    LastSeen
| sort by LastSeen desc
| take 30
content.title: Devices Not Yet Onboarded (Coverage Gap)

content.json:
## Vulnerabilities & CISA KEV Coverage
> **VIB Q1 2026 priority CVEs** (Section 3.1 — check the first grid below for these specifically):
> Cisco Firewall CVE-2026-20131 (CVSS 10.0, Interlock ransomware) · BeyondTrust CVE-2026-1731 (9.9) · Ivanti EPMM CVE-2026-1281/1340 (9.8, MDM) · Fortinet CVE-2026-24858 (9.4) · n8n CVE-2026-21858 (10.0) · Oracle EBS CVE-2025-61882 (Cl0p/FIN11 campaign) · MongoDB CVE-2025-14847 (active AU exploitation)
>
> CVE data sourced from MDE Threat & Vulnerability Management (`DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities`). KEV tiles require the `CISA-KEV` watchlist. See the Setup tab.

content.query:
let PriorityCVEs = dynamic([
    "CVE-2026-20131",
    "CVE-2026-1731",
    "CVE-2026-1281",
    "CVE-2026-1340",
    "CVE-2026-24858",
    "CVE-2026-21858",
    "CVE-2025-61882",
    "CVE-2025-14847"
]);
union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where CveId in (PriorityCVEs)
| project CveId, SoftwareName, SoftwareVendor, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, DeviceName
| sort by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc
content.title: VIB Q1 2026 Priority CVE Exposure (Section 3.1)

content.query:
// Devices matching CISA KEV entries — join MDE TVM with watchlist
let KEV = union isfuzzy=true (_GetWatchlist('CISA-KEV')
    | project cveID=SearchKey,
              vendorProject   = column_ifexists('vendorProject', ''),
              product         = column_ifexists('product', ''),
              dateAdded       = column_ifexists('dateAdded', ''),
              dueDate         = column_ifexists('dueDate', ''),
              knownRansomware = column_ifexists('knownRansomwareCampaignUse', ''));
union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(CveId)
| join kind=inner KEV on $left.CveId == $right.cveID
| extend RansomwareFlag = iff(knownRansomware == "Known", "Ransomware", "")
| extend DaysUntilDue   = iff(isnotempty(dueDate), datetime_diff('day', todatetime(dueDate), now()), int(null))
| project CveId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, DeviceName, dateAdded, dueDate, DaysUntilDue, RansomwareFlag
| sort by DaysUntilDue asc
content.title: Devices Matching CISA KEV Entries
KEV Exposure by Vendor
Devices by CVE Severity (MDE TVM)

content.query:
// Most vulnerable devices — ranked by critical CVE count
union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    TotalCVEs    = dcount(CveId),
    CriticalCVEs = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Critical"),
    HighCVEs     = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "High")
  by DeviceName
| sort by CriticalCVEs desc, HighCVEs desc
| take 25
content.title: Most Vulnerable Devices (by CVE Count)
KEV Dwell Time — Days Since Added to KEV List

content.query:
// ACSC advisories from watchlist
union isfuzzy=true _GetWatchlist('ACSC-Advisories')
| project AdvisoryDate=column_ifexists('date',''), Title=column_ifexists('title', SearchKey), Link=column_ifexists('link',''), CVE=column_ifexists('cve','')
| sort by AdvisoryDate desc
| take 20
content.title: Recent ACSC Advisories (from Watchlist)

content.json:
### Native Defender Vulnerability Findings
> The queries below draw directly from `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` with no watchlist dependency. Use these to understand raw exposure in the estate — highest-impact CVEs to remediate, software with the most open vulnerabilities, and where public exploits exist.

content.query:
// Defender-identified software exposure (native TVM, no enrichment assumptions)
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(SoftwareName)
| summarize
    AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceId),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SoftwareName, SoftwareVendor
| sort by AffectedDevices desc
| take 25
content.title: Top Critical/High CVEs by Device Exposure (no watchlist)

content.query:
// Software packages with the most distinct Critical/High CVEs — identify high-priority patching targets
union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where VulnerabilitySeverityLevel in ("Critical", "High")
| summarize
    DistinctCVEs    = dcount(CveId),
    AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceId),
    CriticalCount   = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "Critical"),
    HighCount       = dcountif(CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel == "High")
  by SoftwareName, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareVersion
| sort by DistinctCVEs desc
| take 20
| project Software=SoftwareName, Vendor=SoftwareVendor, Version=SoftwareVersion,
    ['Total CVEs']=DistinctCVEs, Critical=CriticalCount, High=HighCount, ['Devices Affected']=AffectedDevices
content.title: Software with Most Open Vulnerabilities

content.query:
// CVEs with confirmed public exploits — highest remediation priority regardless of CVSS
union isfuzzy=true DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IsExploitAvailable == 1
| summarize
    AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceId),
    CvssScore       = max(CvssScore),
    Severity        = any(VulnerabilitySeverityLevel),
    Software        = any(SoftwareName),
    Vendor          = any(SoftwareVendor)
  by CveId
| sort by CvssScore desc, AffectedDevices desc
| project CveId, Severity, ['CVSS']=CvssScore, Software, Vendor, ['Affected Devices']=AffectedDevices
content.title: CVEs with Public Exploits Available

content.json:
## Identity Risk
> Draws from Entra ID (`SigninLogs`) and Okta (`Okta_CL` / `OktaSSO`). Risky sign-in data requires Entra ID Identity Protection (P2 licence). Okta queries use `union isfuzzy=true` to handle both legacy DCR connector and the newer CCP connector table names.
>
> If Okta tiles show 0, run the **Setup & Validation** tab to confirm your table name.

content.title: Risky Sign-ins (Entra)
Failed MFA Attempts

content.query:
// Okta authentication failures and policy events
union isfuzzy=true
    (Okta_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('outcome_result_s', '')
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('eventType_s', '')
     | where Outcome =~ "FAILURE"
        or EventType has_any ('mfa', 'policy', 'admin', 'lock')),
    (OktaSSO
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('Outcome_Result', '')
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('EventType', '')
     | where Outcome =~ "FAILURE"
        or EventType has_any ('mfa', 'policy', 'admin', 'lock'))
| summarize ['Okta Auth Failures / Policy Events']=count()
content.title: Okta Failures / Policy Events
Accounts with Risky Sign-ins

content.query:
// Sign-in failure reasons breakdown
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Count=count() by ResultDescription
| sort by Count desc
| take 10
content.title: Sign-in Failure Reasons

content.query:
// Risky sign-ins by country of origin
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
| summarize Count=count() by Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| sort by Count desc
| take 15
content.title: Risky Sign-ins by Country

content.query:
// Risky sign-ins detail — prioritised by risk level
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, ResultType, ResultDescription
| sort by RiskLevelDuringSignIn asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Risky Sign-ins Detail

content.query:
// Okta events - failures, MFA events, admin access, lockouts
union isfuzzy=true
    (Okta_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('eventType_s', '')
     | extend Actor     = column_ifexists('actor_alternateId_s', '')
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('outcome_result_s', '')
     | extend Message   = column_ifexists('displayMessage_s', '')
     | extend Severity  = column_ifexists('severity_s', '')),
    (OktaSSO
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend EventType = column_ifexists('EventType', '')
     | extend Actor     = column_ifexists('Actor_AlternateId', '')
     | extend Outcome   = column_ifexists('Outcome_Result', '')
     | extend Message   = column_ifexists('DisplayMessage', '')
     | extend Severity  = column_ifexists('Severity', ''))
| where Outcome =~ "FAILURE"
   or EventType has_any ('mfa', 'policy', 'admin', 'lock', 'access_admin')
| project TimeGenerated, EventType, Actor, Outcome, Message, Severity
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Okta Failure / Policy Events
Credential Reset → Immediate Login (ShinyHunters Pattern — VIB Section 5.2)

content.query:
// AiTM (Adversary-in-the-Middle) phishing indicators
// VIB Q1 2026 Section 5.3: REN-ISAC advisory — AiTM defeats traditional MFA by proxying sessions
// Indicators: successful MFA auth from unregistered/non-compliant device, high-risk state
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == "0"
| where AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication"
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
    or RiskState has_any ("atRisk", "confirmedCompromised")
| extend DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId)
| extend IsCompliant = tostring(DeviceDetail.isCompliant)
| extend DeviceName = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, DeviceName, IsCompliant, AppDisplayName
| sort by RiskLevelDuringSignIn asc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: AiTM Phishing Indicators — MFA Bypass Risk (VIB Section 5.3)

content.json:
## Alerts & Incidents
Draws from `SecurityAlert` and `SecurityIncident` — standard Sentinel tables that populate from all connected sources (MDE, Defender for O365, Okta, Mimecast, Sentinel analytics rules).

content.title: Incidents by Severity & Status
Alerts by Source

content.query:
// Open incidents — deduplicated to current status
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| extend AgeHours = datetime_diff('hour', now(), CreatedTime)
| project CreatedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Owner=tostring(parse_json(Owner).userPrincipalName), AgeHours, IncidentUrl
| sort by Severity asc, AgeHours desc
content.title: Open Incidents

content.query:
// Recently resolved incidents
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where ClosedTime {TimeRange}
| where Status in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| extend MTTR_hrs = round(datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0, 1)
| project ClosedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Classification, MTTR_hrs, IncidentUrl
| sort by ClosedTime desc
| take 25
content.title: Recently Resolved Incidents

content.json:
## Email Threats
> Draws from Mimecast (`CommonSecurityLog` where DeviceVendor=Mimecast, or `MimecastSEGEvent_CL`) and Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (`EmailEvents`). Uses `union isfuzzy=true` to handle whichever sources are connected.
>
> If all tiles show 0, run the Setup tab to confirm which email tables are populated in your workspace.

content.title: Blocked Email Threats
Phishing Detections
Malware in Email

content.query:
// Distinct users targeted by email threats
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"
     | where DeviceAction has_any ("Block", "Reject", "Hold", "block", "reject")
     | extend TargetUser = column_ifexists('DestinationUserName', column_ifexists('DestinationEmailAddress', ''))
     | where isnotempty(TargetUser)),
    (MimecastSEGEvent_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend TargetUser = column_ifexists('recipientAddress_s', ''))
| summarize ['Users Targeted']=dcount(TargetUser)
content.title: Users Targeted

content.query:
// Email threat volume over time — Mimecast + Defender combined
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"
     | where DeviceAction has_any ("Block", "Reject", "Hold", "block", "reject")
     | extend Source = "Mimecast"),
    (MimecastSEGEvent_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where column_ifexists('action_s','') has_any ("Block", "Reject")
     | extend Source = "Mimecast (SEG)"),
    (EmailEvents
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeliveryAction in ("Blocked", "Replaced")
     | extend Source = "Defender for O365")
| summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Source
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Email Threat Volume Over Time

content.query:
// Email threat type breakdown
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"
     | where DeviceAction has_any ("Block", "Reject", "Hold", "block", "reject")
     | extend ThreatType = column_ifexists('DeviceEventClassID', 'Unknown')),
    (MimecastSEGEvent_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend ThreatType = column_ifexists('type_s', 'Unknown')),
    (EmailEvents
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeliveryAction in ("Blocked", "Replaced")
     | extend ThreatType = ThreatTypes)
| summarize Count=count() by ThreatType
| sort by Count desc
| take 10
content.title: Threat Type Breakdown

content.query:
// Top 20 most targeted users by blocked email threat count
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"
     | where DeviceAction has_any ("Block", "Reject", "Hold", "block", "reject")
     | extend TargetUser = column_ifexists('DestinationUserName', column_ifexists('DestinationEmailAddress', 'Unknown'))),
    (MimecastSEGEvent_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | extend TargetUser = column_ifexists('recipientAddress_s', 'Unknown')),
    (EmailEvents
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeliveryAction in ("Blocked", "Replaced")
     | extend TargetUser = RecipientEmailAddress)
| where TargetUser != "Unknown"
| summarize ThreatCount=count() by TargetUser
| sort by ThreatCount desc
| take 20
content.title: Top 20 Most Targeted Users

content.json:
## Trends
Extend the time range to 30 or 90 days to see trajectory. These charts are the live equivalent of the trajectory section in a quarterly brief.

content.title: Weekly Alert Volume

content.query:
// Weekly incident MTTR trend
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where ClosedTime {TimeRange}
| where Status in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| extend MTTR_hrs = datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0
| summarize AvgMTTR=round(avg(MTTR_hrs), 1) by bin(ClosedTime, 7d)
| sort by ClosedTime asc
content.title: Weekly Avg MTTR (hours)

content.query:
// Weekly high-risk device count - is exposure increasing or decreasing?
union isfuzzy=true DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| extend RiskScore = column_ifexists('RiskScore', 'Unknown')
| where RiskScore in ("High", "Critical")
| summarize HighRiskDevices=dcount(DeviceId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 7d)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Weekly High-Risk Device Count
Weekly Risky Sign-ins

content.query:
// Weekly P1/P2 incident creation trend
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Severity in ("Critical", "High")
| summarize P1P2Count=count() by bin(CreatedTime, 7d)
| sort by CreatedTime asc
content.title: Weekly P1/P2 Incidents

content.query:
// Weekly blocked email threat volume
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"
     | where DeviceAction has_any ("Block", "Reject", "block", "reject")),
    (MimecastSEGEvent_CL
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where column_ifexists('action_s','') has_any ("Block", "Reject")),
    (EmailEvents
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | where DeliveryAction in ("Blocked", "Replaced"))
| summarize BlockedThreats=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 7d)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Weekly Blocked Email Threats

content.json:
## Cloud Posture (AWS)
> Sourced from `AWSGuardDuty` (security findings) and `AWSCloudTrail` (API audit logs) via the AWS S3 connector. GuardDuty severity is numeric: Low=1-3.9, Medium=4-6.9, High=7-10.
>
> CloudTrail tiles focus on high-signal events: root account usage, IAM privilege changes, and failed API calls. Extend the time range to 30 days to see trajectory.

content.title: GuardDuty High / Critical Findings
Root Account Events

content.query:
// IAM privilege escalation events — user/role creation, policy attachment, access key creation
union isfuzzy=true AWSCloudTrail
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventName in ("CreateUser", "CreateRole", "AttachUserPolicy", "PutUserPolicy",
                      "CreateAccessKey", "AddUserToGroup", "AttachRolePolicy",
                      "PutRolePolicy", "CreateLoginProfile", "UpdateLoginProfile")
| summarize ['IAM Privilege Events']=count()
content.title: IAM Privilege Events
Failed API Calls
AWS Accounts in Scope
GuardDuty Finding Categories

content.query:
// GuardDuty finding volume over time by severity band
union isfuzzy=true AWSGuardDuty
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend SeverityBand = case(
    Severity >= 7.0, "High",
    Severity >= 4.0, "Medium",
    "Low")
| summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), SeverityBand
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: GuardDuty Finding Trend

content.query:
// Active GuardDuty findings — prioritised by severity for triage
union isfuzzy=true AWSGuardDuty
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity >= 4.0
| extend SeverityBand = case(
    Severity >= 7.0, "High",
    Severity >= 4.0, "Medium",
    "Low")
| extend AccountId = column_ifexists('AccountId', '')
| extend Region    = column_ifexists('Region', '')
| project TimeGenerated, Title, Type, SeverityBand, Severity, AccountId, Region
| sort by Severity desc, TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Active GuardDuty Findings (Medium+)

content.query:
// CloudTrail — root account usage detail
union isfuzzy=true AWSCloudTrail
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where UserIdentityType == "Root"
| project TimeGenerated, EventName, EventSource, SourceIpAddress, AWSRegion, ErrorCode
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 25
content.title: Root Account Usage Detail

content.query:
// CloudTrail — IAM privilege escalation events detail
union isfuzzy=true AWSCloudTrail
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventName in ("CreateUser", "CreateRole", "AttachUserPolicy", "PutUserPolicy",
                      "CreateAccessKey", "AddUserToGroup", "AttachRolePolicy",
                      "PutRolePolicy", "CreateLoginProfile", "UpdateLoginProfile")
| project TimeGenerated, EventName, UserIdentityArn, UserIdentityType, SourceIpAddress, AWSRegion, ErrorCode, AccountId=RecipientAccountId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: IAM Privilege Events Detail

content.query:
// CloudTrail — top error codes (failed API calls) — useful for spotting misconfigurations and brute force
union isfuzzy=true AWSCloudTrail
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(ErrorCode)
| summarize Count=count() by ErrorCode, EventSource
| sort by Count desc
| take 15
content.title: Top API Error Codes

content.query:
// CloudTrail — S3 bucket configuration changes (data exfiltration risk)
union isfuzzy=true AWSCloudTrail
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventSource == "s3.amazonaws.com"
| where EventName in ("PutBucketPolicy", "DeleteBucketPolicy", "PutBucketAcl",
                      "PutBucketPublicAccessBlock", "DeleteBucketEncryption",
                      "PutBucketCORS", "DeleteBucketCORS")

## Generative AI Usage
> Data source: **`DeviceNetworkEvents`** (MDE endpoint DNS/network traffic). Requires MDE onboarding and network protection enabled on endpoints.
>
> **Domain list:** managed via Sentinel watchlist **`AI-App-Domains`** (SearchKey = `Domain`). To add apps detected in Cloud Discovery: update the watchlist CSV and re-import, or edit rows directly in Sentinel → Watchlists → AI-App-Domains.
>
> Risk scores: **Critical ≤ 2** (nation-state data residency risk, e.g. DeepSeek) · **High ≤ 4** (privacy or inappropriate content risk) · **Medium ≤ 6** (consumer tools, limited enterprise controls) · **Low ≤ 9** (enterprise-grade or Microsoft-native)
>

content.query:
// AI app domain map loaded from Sentinel watchlist 'AI-App-Domains'
// To update: Defender portal or Sentinel > Watchlists > AI-App-Domains
let AIApps = union isfuzzy=true (_GetWatchlist('AI-App-Domains')
    | project
        Domain    = column_ifexists('Domain', SearchKey),
        AppName   = column_ifexists('AppName', ''),
        RiskScore = toint(column_ifexists('RiskScore', '6')),
        Risk      = column_ifexists('Risk', 'Medium')
    | where isnotempty(Domain));
let AppDomains = AIApps | project Domain;
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, RemoteUrl:string,
               ActionType:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
               DeviceName:string) [])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ActionType != "InboundInternetScanInspected"
| extend CleanHost = tolower(trim_start(@"www.", tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host)))
| where isnotempty(CleanHost)
// Extract 2-level (deepseek.com) and 3-level (gemini.google.com) domain suffixes
| extend Domain2 = extract(@"([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})$", 1, CleanHost)
| extend Domain3 = extract(@"([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})$", 1, CleanHost)
| where Domain2 in (AppDomains) or Domain3 in (AppDomains)
// Prefer the 3-level match when it exists in the app map
| extend MatchDomain = iff(Domain3 in (AppDomains), Domain3, Domain2)
| join kind=inner AIApps on $left.MatchDomain == $right.Domain
| summarize ['AI Apps with Activity']=dcount(AppName)

## MCP Registry Activity
> **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** registries are marketplaces where users discover and install MCP servers — plugins that give AI assistants direct access to files, databases, APIs, and system tools.
>
> Visits to these sites indicate active exploration or installation of AI agent capabilities. This is not inherently malicious, but warrants awareness: installed MCPs run with the permissions of the user and can exfiltrate data through any connected AI backend.
>
> **Known high-risk MCP servers** (prompt injection, credential harvesting) have been documented against smithery.ai and composio.dev — review any sustained usage, especially from non-developer roles.

content.query:
// MCP Registry and Hosting Platform Activity
// Filters watchlist to entries tagged 'MCP Registry' or 'MCP Host' or 'MCP Hub'
// Intent signal: browsing these sites indicates active MCP discovery or installation
let AIApps = union isfuzzy=true (_GetWatchlist('AI-App-Domains')
    | project
        Domain    = column_ifexists('Domain', SearchKey),
        AppName   = column_ifexists('AppName', ''),
        RiskScore = toint(column_ifexists('RiskScore', '6')),
        Risk      = column_ifexists('Risk', 'Medium')
    | where isnotempty(Domain)
    | where AppName startswith "MCP");
let AppDomains = AIApps | project Domain;
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, RemoteUrl:string,
               ActionType:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
               DeviceName:string) [])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ActionType != "InboundInternetScanInspected"
| extend CleanHost = tolower(trim_start(@"www.", tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host)))

    LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated),

## Setup & Validation

### VIB Q1 2026 Readiness — Workbook Coverage Map
The table below maps each item from the VIB Section 6 readiness assessment to the workbook panel that provides live monitoring coverage.

> **Note on CVE detection scope:** MDE TVM only covers devices onboarded to MDE. Network appliances (Cisco, Fortinet) and server-side platforms (Oracle EBS, n8n, MongoDB) may not be in MDE scope. Cross-reference the Device Risk tab's coverage gap grid with the priority CVE list.

Run these queries once after configuring connectors. Results confirm which tables are populating and let you verify the workbook will return data.

content.json:
---
### Notes

**Okta table names** depend on the connector version:
- Legacy DCR: `Okta_CL` — column names use `camelCase_s` suffix
- CCP (newer): `OktaSSO` — column names are clean (no suffix)

All Identity tab queries use `union isfuzzy=true` to handle both. If you see unexpected nulls, check which table is active from Step 2 above and verify the column names with `getschema Okta_CL`.

**Mimecast table names** depend on the connector:
- Via CEF/Syslog: `CommonSecurityLog | where DeviceVendor =~ "Mimecast"`
- Via Mimecast SEG connector: `MimecastSEGEvent_CL`

**Entra ID risk data** (`RiskLevelDuringSignIn`) requires Azure AD Identity Protection P2 licence. Without it the column exists but all values are `none`.

**DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities** may have a lag of up to 24 hours from MDE. Query `ago(2d)` if data appears sparse.
